name: Reus Airport
before:
A small Costa Daurada airport between Constantí and Reus, about 8 km from the centre of Tarragona. It handles a lot of holiday traffic for Salou and Cambrils, and PortAventura World is close by.

The name is a trap. The airport is also marketed as Barcelona-Reus, but Barcelona is about 103 km away to the north east. A client who books it expecting a Barcelona city arrival will face a long transfer, so be explicit about the distance when quoting.

The terminal is small and the gate arrangement reflects that. There are 9 gates: 1 to 3 for Schengen flights and 4 to 9 for non-Schengen, with passport control before the second lounge. Three gates were removed in 2023 because the terminal was too small to run passport checks at the gate efficiently.

Traffic has swung a lot over the years, peaking at 1.7 million in 2009, falling to 705,067 by 2015, then recovering past a million again in 2017.
after:
A small Costa Daurada airport between Reus and Tarragona. It handles a lot of holiday traffic for Salou and Cambrils, and PortAventura World is close by.

Its name is a trap. The airport is also marketed as Barcelona-Reus, but Barcelona is about 100 km away to the north east. A client who books it expecting a Barcelona city arrival will face a long transfer, so be explicit about the distance when quoting.

It handled more than 1.3 million passengers in 2025, up 13 per cent on 2024.

claims.note: Aena's ACI awards put Reus in the smallest European size band (under 2 million passengers a year); it handled about 1.3 million in 2025.

claims.note: Replaces "between Constantí and Reus, about 8 km from the centre of Tarragona" (see the two cuts). The coordinates put the airport 5.2 km east of Reus and 7.2 km north west of Tarragona, almost on the straight line between them, and its address is on the Tarragona to Reus road. Aena's own wording is that it is about 10 km east of Reus and from the centre of Tarragona.

claims.inAfter: The airport is also marketed as Barcelona-Reus
claims.note: Ryanair, the airline that carried half the airport's passengers in 2022 (Diari de Tarragona), names the airport Barcelona Reus in its own airport data and files it under its Barcelona city code. Aena itself calls it Reus Airport.

claims.claim: Barcelona is about 100 km away to the north east
claims.inAfter: Barcelona is about 100 km away to the north east
claims.note: Was "about 103 km". The coordinates give 87.0 km in a straight line from the centre of Barcelona (100 km is a ratio of 1.15, inside the 0.8 to 1.6 allowed for a road distance; 103 km is 1.18), and put Barcelona at 72 degrees from the airport, which is east on the 8-point rose and one point from north east, inside the tolerance. No written source other than Wikipedia gave a figure: tried Salou's and Barcelona's tourism boards, Monbus (which runs the airport to Barcelona coach), Catalan News, El País and the Diputació de Tarragona; the Costa Daurada tourism board (costadaurada.info) refused the connection. So the figure is rounded to what both sources support rather than kept at Wikipedia's 103.

claims.inAfter: It handled more than 1.3 million passengers in 2025
claims.note: Replaces the 2009 to 2017 history (see the cut). Aena 1,336,826 and Eurostat 1,323,472, 1 per cent apart; "more than 1.3 million" is true of both.
Aena gives 13.1 per cent; Eurostat's figures give 13.2 per cent (1,168,899 to 1,323,472). Catalan News reported 13.2 per cent for January to November from Aena data.
